authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES leftover-design work for DR-133 NT-3 and NT-5 only. It does not add a DR-G* row, does not change required-now 18, does not close leftover-design, does not open D-056 Class A, does not SATISFY DR-133, does not edit file 08, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: State that NT-3 and NT-5 leftover-design is well-formed host admission, which no live gate corpus exercises, and propose — as candidate-not-adopted — one later DR-G* obligation whose corpus includes hostile-but-well-formed admission inputs. This artifact does not add that row.

basedOn.role: Measurement: NT-1/2/4/6/7 can ride G20/G21 after D-145 naming. NT-3 and NT-5 remain leftover-design.

namingPin.role: Names NT-1/2/6 at G21 and NT-4/7 at G20. Does not name NT-3 or NT-5.

classes.name: fact-candidate-masquerade
classes.inputVerbatim: A FactCandidateV1 whose relationSchemaId or payload is provider-minted or mismatched so as to carry a findingLikeResult.
classes.passVerbatim: Host-owned relation registry rejects before fact admission. Value is not reinterpreted as a Finding.
classes.whyNotG21: G21 corpus is crash/panic/timeout/resource/malformed/truncated/duplicate/EOF/process-tree/recovery. NT-3 input is a well-formed FactCandidate on an admitted frame type. Candidate discard is post-fault leak prevention, not relation-registry admission.
classes.whyNotG20: G20 corpus is envelopes/logs/progress/config/doctor/exit and no-final-authority. It does not own relationSchemaId admission.
classes.whyNotG10: G10 is opacity / one-shot / fate-compat goldens. Not host relation-registry admission.

classes.name: coverage-domain-mutation
classes.inputVerbatim: A Coverage payload that narrows, widens, or converts unknown to covered relative to the host-requested domain.
classes.passVerbatim: Host refuses the domain mutation. Sufficiency remains host-owned. No unknown-to-covered conversion.
classes.whyNotG21: G21 Coverage goldens are containment/honesty after fault. They do not exercise host refusal of a well-formed Coverage payload that mutates the requested domain.
classes.whyNotG20: G20 does not mention Coverage-domain sufficiency.
classes.whyNotG10: G10 goldens are not Coverage-domain admission.

proposedObligation.numberNote: G23 is a candidate identifier. The later MF-6 assigns or remints the number if another adopted row takes G23 first. This artifact does not add the row.
proposedObligation.claim: Host admission of well-formed TypeScript-provider FactCandidate and Coverage payloads refuses finding-masquerade and Coverage-domain mutation. Corpus is hostile-but-well-formed admission inputs, not crash/malformed failure containment.
corpusDraft: FactCandidateV1 with provider-minted or mismatched relationSchemaId or payload carrying findingLikeResult — must reject before fact admission
Coverage payload that narrows, widens, or converts unknown to covered relative to the host-requested domain — must refuse; no unknown-to-covered conversion
proposedObligation.requiredNowEffectIfAdoptedLater: If a later MF-6 adds this row to the required-now set, D-086 required-now cardinality becomes 19 of 19. That cardinality change is the later MF-6's scoped D-002 / D-086 successor, not this artifact.

doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone: This candidate does not make DR-133 D-056-eligible. NT-3 and NT-5 remain leftover-design until a later D-000 MF-6 adds the proposed DR-G* row with this owner and corpus. D-056 Class A is not opened. Gates 2 and 3 do not hold.
doesNot: Does not open D-056 Class A.
Does not add a DR-G* row.
Does not retarget D-145 naming of NT-1/2/4/6/7.
Does not assign NT-3 or NT-5 to G10, G20, or G21.
